description: This file defines the MyLeaveRequestAPI class, which extends EmployeeLeaveRequestAPI and provides API endpoints for managing leave requests specific to the authenticated user in the OrangeHRM HRM system. It includes methods for retrieving, creating, updating, and validating leave requests, with detailed API documentation annotations.

classes.name: MyLeaveRequestAPI
classes.description: API class for authenticated user's leave requests, providing endpoints for retrieval, creation, and modification of leave requests with detailed API documentation annotations.

methods.name: getLeaveApplicationService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of LeaveApplicationService.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific leave request by ID for the authenticated user; inherits implementation from parent.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all leave requests for the authenticated user, applying search filters and returning detailed models.

methods.name: getDefaultIncludeEmployees
methods.description: Returns default value for including employee info in search filters.

methods.name: getDefaultStatuses
methods.description: Returns default leave request statuses used in filtering.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the GET all requests, inheriting from parent.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new leave request for the authenticated user, returning detailed data or summary based on requested model.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the leave request creation payload.

methods.name: checkLeaveRequestAccessible
methods.description: Ensures that the current user has access to the specified leave request.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates a leave request, inheriting implementation from parent.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletion is not implemented; throws exception if called.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Deletion validation rules are not implemented; throws exception if called.
